scientific_receiving.assembly: Independent analytic coordinate oracle for identity plus proper 90-degree Z rotation and unit-bearing translation; declared common/repeated chain sets, structures [2,0,2]/[1], nm/angstrom/pm, times and structure IDs. Stored assembly/default-first-frame and native rejection of bad frames/missing name/heterogeneous chains are preserved. scientific_receiving.hydrogen_projection: Declared six-atom methanol retains source indices [0,1,5], transfers [0.1,0.2,0.3] elementary_charge into the parent and preserves total charge within the native 1e-12 tolerance. Source IDs/names and H versus HD are explicit; omitted atoms remain distinct from merged H. Retained coordinates, structure repetitions, state/syntax choices, virtual H inventory, JSON report, representative lineage composition and output-only analysis invalidation are checked.
scientific_receiving.unit_policy: Assembly geometry is compared in explicit nm under nm/angstrom/pm policies. Projection retains canonical charge_unit=elementary_charge and values under alternate length/charge policies; serialized quantity fields are checked before interpretation.
scientific_receiving.provenance: Real explicitly prepared caffeine reduces 24 atoms to 14, conserves charge and retains derived typing/charge assignments with Gasteiger-Marsili source software/provenance. Reports detach from subsequent calculations; public output edits preserve the view.
scientific_receiving.unqualified: No biological-model certification, implicit chain/chemistry inference, arbitrary force-field united-atom semantics, graphical workflow, GPU/out-of-core execution or H5MSM 0.5 mechanics persistence qualification.

diagnosis: First failure: a nullable/object pandas Series was sent to NumPy comparison without an explicit float representation in the test; four parametrized cases also returned early without exercising assembly and are excluded as acceptance evidence.

Remove the four vacuous cases and add twelve real state/selection cases; the next failure compared a native floating-roundoff charge (-5.55e-17) to zero with atol=0. The final test uses the explicitly declared native charge_conservation_tolerance (1e-12). No runtime conversion or scientific algorithm changes.
initial_receiving.exploratory_probe: An initial pentalanine assembly probe printed coordinates.shape on a native empty result after requesting undeclared chain membership. This was an invalid positive fixture/diagnostic, not an established native defect. Positive controls use declared-chain fixtures and bundled Barnase-Barstar; no consumer inference or workaround is added.
